notes: Fighter class 0x7104f6a5b8 (608 bytes, no RTTI name); the 112-byte class 0x71051798b8 is a stub implementation. Construction is inlined (allocation 0x260, vptr store, then vslots 0x2F8 and 0x310); the boma keeps it at +0xA0. Initial values: f32 1.0 at 0xE0, 0xF0-0x108, 0x194-0x1A4, 0x1AC-0x1B4, 0x1BC-0x1C8, 0x1E0, 0x1EC, 0x20C, 0x210, 0x228, 0x230; 0x38 and 0x1DC 0x50000000; 0x34 -1; 0x3C 6; 0x1F8 hash40 top; 0x200-0x208 -1; 0x23A/0x23B 1; 0x178 points at 0x180; the rest 0. The arrays are not owned by the constructor: setup vslot 0x28 copies counts/pointers 0x50-0x78, 0xD0/0xD8, 0x1E4/0x1E8, 0x234 from a config block. Per-status start vslot 0x38 rewrites 0x20-0x4A, 0x80, 0x90-0xAF, 0xC8, 0xE0-0x108, 0x194-0x1B0, 0x1C4-0x1DC, 0x1F8-0x208, 0x228, 0x238-0x241. Per-id getters with absolute=true read the 0x150-byte record at [0x78], else the 0x130-byte record at [0x68]; path = load then offset for id 0 (add id*stride). Getters marked computed delegate to LinkModule (boma+0xD0) when its vslot 0x278/0x2A0 says the object is linked. Null exports resolved via the vtable: attack_data 0x1E8 (returns record address: [0x68]+id*0x130, or [0x78]+id*0x150+0x10), get_lr 0x378, get_power 0x158, center_pos 0x1C8, pos_x 0x1B0, set_power 0xF8 etc. Not decoded: vslot 0x18 (lua command dispatcher), 0x30/0x388/0x390 (per-frame update), get_power / get_power_apply_defense formulas, attack_direction axis switch details.
